verdict.summary: The change consistently removes the misleading body-backed provider selector, documents the actual label-only contract in both the issue form and README, and preserves fail-closed provider and grant behavior in the broker. The added self-tests are non-vacuous: they require at least one parsed form element, reject any element type capable of carrying broker request values beyond the explicitly permitted acknowledgement/markdown types, and independently require both provider-label literals in non-comment form content. No trust check, workflow permission, routing rule, or executable workflow path is weakened by this diff.
